name: Agentic score
summary: The agentic score says how far an AI agent can go with a business through doors the business published: message, book, order, cancel and negotiate, and the journey around them. It counts what applies to that kind of business, and nothing else, by the weights below, from what we read on the business's own site and doors, each with its source and date. It is not a certification, it never changes the directory's search order, and nobody can pay for it.

capabilities.label: Find
capabilities.question: Can an agent read who the business is, its opening hours and where it is?

capabilities.label: Catalogue
capabilities.question: Can an agent read its services, products or menu, with prices?

capabilities.label: Availability
capabilities.question: Can an agent check free slots or stock?

capabilities.label: Message
capabilities.question: Can an agent send the business a message and get an answer?

capabilities.label: Negotiate
capabilities.question: Can an agent ask for a quote, make an offer or get a counter-offer?

capabilities.label: Book
capabilities.question: Can an agent make a booking, with its details?

capabilities.label: Order
capabilities.question: Can an agent place an order, with its options?

capabilities.label: Pay
capabilities.question: Can an agent pay, and is it clear how payment happens?

capabilities.label: Change
capabilities.question: Can an agent change a booking or an order?

capabilities.label: Cancel
capabilities.question: Can an agent cancel a booking or an order?

capabilities.label: Track
capabilities.question: Can an agent see the status of a booking, an order or a delivery?

capabilities.label: Return or refund
capabilities.question: Can an agent start a return, a refund or an exchange?

capabilities.label: Receipt
capabilities.question: Can an agent get a receipt or an invoice?

capabilities.label: Feedback
capabilities.question: Can an agent leave feedback or a review?

capabilities.label: Membership
capabilities.question: Can an agent pause, resume or end a membership or subscription?

capabilities.label: Vouchers
capabilities.question: Can an agent use a gift card, a voucher or loyalty points?

capabilities.label: Waitlist
capabilities.question: Can an agent join a waitlist?

capabilities.label: Support
capabilities.question: Can an agent raise a complaint or a problem with an order?

capabilities.label: Policies
capabilities.question: Can an agent read the cancellation, return, deposit or no-show policy?

formula:
For profile P: A_g = members(g) ∩ applicable(P), for each group g with weight > 0. A group with A_g = ∅ is dropped.
possible = Σ_{g: A_g≠∅} W_g
N        = Σ_{g: A_g≠∅} W_g × s_g × (60 / |A_g|)      where s_g = Σ_{c∈A_g} halves(c)   (|A_g| ≤ 5; 60 = lcm(1..5))
D        = 120 × possible
score    = (100 × N + D/2) div D                       (round half up; 0..100)
grade    = A ≥ 80, B ≥ 60, C ≥ 40, D ≥ 20, E < 20
rank: score, then the most recent check, then domain; over businesses not hidden by their owner and of kinds the directory lists
named: a business is named on leaderboards, and its result page may be indexed, when it is agent-ready (askable or above), has claimed its listing with a proof, or links to its own result page; others are counted, not named
directory: The agentic score never changes a business's place in the directory's search order (https://surfingdog.ai/v1/ranking).
not_certification: This is not a certification: it is what was read on the business's own site and doors on the date shown.

find.title: Publish who you are, when you are open and where
find.how: Add schema.org LocalBusiness markup (its most specific type) with name, address, geo and openingHoursSpecification.

catalogue.title: Publish your services and prices for machines
catalogue.how: Add schema.org Service, Product or Menu items with Offer prices to your pages, publish a UCP catalog, or add a tool such as list_services<door>.

availability.title: Let agents check availability
availability.how: Add a tool or operation such as check_availability<door>, or publish stock with your catalogue.

message.title: Let agents send you a message
message.how: Publish a door that takes messages: an agent inbox, an A2A skill, or a tool such as send_message<door>.

negotiate.title: Let agents ask for a quote
negotiate.how: Add a tool such as request_quote or make_offer<door>, or take quote requests in an agent inbox.

book.title: Let agents book
book.how: Add a tool or operation that creates a booking, such as create_booking or POST /bookings<door>; if you use a booking platform, ask it whether it offers an agent door and declare it.

order.title: Let agents order
order.how: Publish UCP or ACP checkout, or add a tool or operation that creates an order, such as create_order<door>.

pay.title: Let agents pay
pay.how: Accept payment through the agent (UCP payment handlers, ACP delegated payment, AP2 or x402, or a pay tool<door>), and state in your structured data how payment happens.

change.title: Let agents change a booking or an order
change.how: Add a tool or operation such as reschedule_booking or PATCH /orders/{id}<door>.

cancel.title: Let agents cancel
cancel.how: Add a tool or operation such as cancel_booking or DELETE /bookings/{id}<door>, and publish your cancellation policy.

track.title: Let agents see the status
track.how: Add a tool or operation such as get_order_status or GET /orders/{id}<door>.

return.title: Let agents start a return or refund
return.how: Add a tool such as request_return<door>, and mark up your returns policy (schema.org MerchantReturnPolicy).

receipt.title: Let agents get a receipt or invoice
receipt.how: Add a tool or operation such as get_invoice<door>.

subscription.title: Let agents manage a membership
subscription.how: Add tools to pause, resume or end a membership<door>.

policies.title: Publish your policies for machines
policies.how: Mark up your returns policy (schema.org MerchantReturnPolicy), link your cancellation, deposit and no-show policies from your pages, or add a tool that returns them<door>.

changelog.summary: The agentic score: capabilities by kind of business, published weights, declared evidence.
